about: Search-reach corpus (job-board .103). Real titles, companies and departments returned by 86 read-only list probes of the live board on 2026-11-17 (POST, x-rb-budget: probe, x-rb-caller: maintenance, limit 60, groupSimilar false), pooled by query family; each query is read against its family's pool (the negative family also against the front end and back end pools). base = the pool rows the title reads of 0b9d5dfab (search-alias.ts and search-routing.ts at that commit, no query join, no role swap) match, decided by pglite with the shipped tsvector expressions. live = the probe's own total and route. Relevance is src/test/helpers/search-reach.ts relevant(), which never reads either matcher.
